subject.title: fix(moonshot): resolve Kimi search secret refs

question: Should an explicitly configured but unresolved Kimi SecretRef fail closed rather than use ambient KIMI_API_KEY or MOONSHOT_API_KEY values?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but it changes credential precedence for existing configurations and therefore determines whether an explicit configuration error can silently select a different credential source.

options.title: Accept fail-closed configured refs
options.body: Merge the shared-resolver behavior so explicit Kimi configuration always takes precedence and unresolved references return a clear missing-key error.

options.title: Preserve legacy ambient fallback
options.body: Keep fallback for unresolved configured references, accepting that an explicit configuration error may run searches with a different ambient credential.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed configured refs
recommendation.body: Merge the shared-resolver behavior so explicit Kimi configuration always takes precedence and unresolved references return a clear missing-key error.
